summary: Verified all 4 shipped changes (#1 Docroot editor, #2 Quiet CPANEL_AUTH_FAILURE + provider-sync-note, #3 Plan addon allowance row, #4 Hero polish). All acceptance criteria pass. Login worked with no 2FA. On the live account (namea3a5) with 0 addons: Domains tab correctly shows the calm blue provider-sync-note, addon add box + '0 of 1 used' quota, and user is NOT logged out despite the /domains CPANEL_AUTH_FAILURE. No CPANEL_AUTH_FAILURE console.error was emitted (previously spammy — now quiet). Docroot toggle not visible (expected: no addons on this account). SSL tab loaded without provider-sync-note (acceptable). Subdomains regression OK. Hero pages (/hosting, /vps, /rdp, /pricing) all render nw-kicker without square brackets, no nw-grid-bg, and no horizontal scroll at 390px on /hosting.
critical_code_review_comments: Two unrelated 403s were observed in console during the Advanced cPanel modal open (likely an auxiliary endpoint). They do not cause logout or affect the tested flows, but E1 may want to audit which endpoint returns 403 for this account and either silence or handle gracefully similar to the CPANEL_AUTH_FAILURE quiet-log policy.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only verification only, no mutations performed.
